title: Roam Daily Notes Graph Growth by Month
dataSources: Obsidian graph stats (`obsidian:stats`), Roam daily notes (`roam:daily`), Logseq tasks (`logseq:task`), Zettelkasten notes (`zettel:note`), PKM review summaries (`pkm:review`).
app: Obsidian graph stats, Roam daily notes, Logseq task exports, and Zettelkasten counts streamed to Splunk HEC via plugins, CSV exports, and scripted vault scans.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=roam:daily
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats max(daily_note_words) as month_end_value by _time
| sort - _time
description: Shows month-end growth for the main roam daily notes metric so long-term accumulation is easy to see.
value: Growth-by-month is a useful antidote to daily noise because it keeps the focus on the steady build of the knowledge base.
implementation: Use a stable month-end summary event if the source emits many small updates each day.
visualization: Line chart of month-end daily note words.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how your roam daily notes system is growing over the long run.
